lines.say: Blurting works. But only half of it.
Close your notes. Write everything you remember about cells.
Feels like a lot. Now check it against your notes.
The gaps are the point. That's what you revise next.
Testing yourself beats going over your notes, even when it feels harder.
And spacing the tests out stops it fading.
Offload plans those tests from your notes and exam dates.
It brings back what you missed, before you forget it.
You just click the link in your calendar and show up.
